inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Data Connector Health Check -Azure Container Registries

properties.description: This rule will identify if any Container Registry stopped reporting to Sentinel in last 7 days.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Data Connector Health Check -Azure Container Registries
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true 
    (ContainerRegistryLoginEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | extend ResourceName = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[8])
    | summarize LastCall1 = max(TimeGenerated) by ResourceName, Type),
    (ContainerRegistryRepositoryEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
    | extend ResourceName = tostring(split(_ResourceId, "/")[8])
    | summarize LastCall1 = max(TimeGenerated) by ResourceName, Type)
| extend Dataconnector = "Azure Container Registies"
| summarize LastCall = max(LastCall1) by Dataconnector, ResourceName
| extend LogIngestionStatus = iff(LastCall < ago(7d), 'No', 'Yes')
| where LogIngestionStatus == "No"
